question: Who was the first Chief Election Commissioner of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Sukumar Sen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sukumar Sen** was the first **Chief Election Commissioner (CEC)** of India. He held this position from **21 March 1950 to 19 December 1958**.
 
• He was instrumental in conducting the **first-ever general elections in India** during 1951–52, which was a massive and historic task for a newly independent nation.
 
• **Sukumar Sen** was an alumnus of the **University of London** and a member of the prestigious **Indian Civil Service (ICS)** of the 1921 batch.
 
• He is credited with organizing elections in a country with a population of approximately **173 million voters** at that time, many of whom were illiterate and unfamiliar with the electoral process.
 
• To address the challenge of illiteracy, **symbols were introduced** on ballot papers to help voters identify their preferred candidates or parties.
 
• His leadership and administrative skills were widely recognized for successfully conducting elections in a diverse and complex country like India.
 
• He also served as the Chief Election Commissioner for **Sudan's first parliamentary elections in 1953**, showcasing his expertise on an international level.
 
• The work done by **Sukumar Sen** laid the foundation for the robust electoral system that India follows to this day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **V Narahari Rao**__

 __
 
• He was the **first Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India** from 1948 to 1954.
 
• His work was primarily focused on auditing government accounts and ensuring financial accountability in India.
 
 
 
• **HK Kripalani**__
 __
 
• He was a prominent **freedom fighter** and an active member of the **Indian National Congress**.
 
• He was not associated with the Election Commission of India.
 
 
 
• **MC Setalvad**__
 
 
• MC Setalvad was the **first Attorney General of India**, serving from 1950 to 1963.
 
• He played a key role in advising the government on legal and constitutional matters.
